thought.text: Ada `main.js`. Saya cari endpoint registrasi di dalamnya.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 60 "https://s.uicdn.com/mampkg/@mamdev/umreg.registration-app2@8.38.0/main.js" -o /tmp/main.js -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"; echo "=== endpoint registrasi ==="; grep -oE '"/[a-z0-9/_.-]{3,40}"' /tmp/main.js | sort -u | grep -iE 'regist|account|user|captcha|verify|check' | head -20

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 60 \"https://s.uicdn.com/mampkg/@mamdev/umreg.registration-app2@8.38.0/main.js\" -o /tmp/main.js -w \"HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\\n\"; echo \"=== endpoint registrasi ===\"; grep -oE '\"/[a-z0-9/_.-]{3,40}\"' /tmp/main.js | sort -u | grep -iE 'regist|account|user|captcha|verify|check' | head -20", "summary": "Download main.js and find endpoints", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 120}
